notes: CDER Office of Compounding Quality and Compliance letter from a review of NativeMed's website (no on-site inspection). Charges are misbranding under 502(a)/502(bb) for false or misleading claims about compounded semaglutide and tirzepatide products (falsely implying NativeMed is the compounder, and claiming the same active ingredient as Ozempic/Wegovy), framed around the 503A/503B compounding exemption scheme. Classified as 'compounding' rather than 'unapproved_drug_marketing' because the charge is misbranding of compounded drugs under 502(bb) (a compounding-specific provision), not a 505(a) unapproved-new-drug claim; judgment call given both types could plausibly fit. location_contains is null since no facility was inspected, though the letter does state an FEI for the website domain's associated establishment.
